Metadata.title: AgiMate — Multi-Agent AI Platform for Business
Metadata.description: AgiMate is a platform where specialized AI agents work together: email, calendar, marketplaces. Each knows its job. Each under your control.
Metadata.ogTitle: AgiMate — AI Agent Team for Your Business
Metadata.ogDescription: Specialized AI agents work in parallel, securely, and under your control. Open-source automation platform.

hero.title: Your AI assistant.
hero.titleHighlight: A team, not a solo act.
hero.subtitle: AgiMate is a platform where specialized AI agents work together: one monitors email, another handles the calendar, a third manages orders. Each knows its job. Each under your control.

items.title: One agent — one task
items.description: While your AI checks the calendar, it misses an incoming email. You get an outdated answer.

items.title: All or nothing
items.description: Your AI assistant has access to everything — email, files, banking. One malicious plugin and the entire system is compromised.

items.title: Black box
items.description: You don't know what AI does behind the scenes. Which APIs did it call? What did it read? Where did it send your data?

solution.title: A team of AI specialists, each in their place

columns.title: Work in parallel
columns.description: While one agent checks the calendar, another reads email. Results are combined instantly.

columns.title: Each — only their own
columns.description: The email agent can't access files. The analytics agent can't send messages. Security is built in, not bolted on.

columns.title: Everything under control
columns.description: Every action of every agent is logged. You see who did what and can set the rules.

tabs.label: Event
tabs.title: An event starts the process
tabs.description: You write in Telegram. Or an email arrives. Or stock runs low. AgiMate receives the event and gets to work.

tabs.label: Team works
tabs.title: Agents work in parallel
tabs.description: AgiMate routes the event to the right agents. The Supervisor coordinates. Agents share context and work simultaneously.

tabs.label: Result
tabs.title: Response and audit log
tabs.description: The Supervisor collects agent responses and sends you the result. Every action is recorded in the log.

useCases.title: What it looks like in practice
useCases.subtitle: Real scenarios where a team of agents outperforms a solo AI

items.title: "Am I free today?"
items.description: You ask in Telegram: "Am I free from 5 to 6?" The calendar agent starts checking. But the email agent spots a message from your boss: "Meeting at 5 PM." The Supervisor responds: "No — a meeting email just came in."

items.title: Smart procurement
items.description: A product is running low on Ozon. The marketplace agent reports it. The Supervisor asks to check supplier prices. But the analytics agent notices: 3 returns this week. The Supervisor asks you: "Should we reorder? Here are the numbers."

items.title: Meeting prep
items.description: An hour before a call, the calendar agent alerts you. The Supervisor simultaneously requests recent correspondence and deal status. In a minute you get a brief: "Ivanov wants to discuss a discount. Deal at $50K, negotiation stage."

items.title: AI secretary
items.description: While you're busy, email and messenger agents monitor incoming messages. Routine questions — they answer themselves. Important ones go to the Supervisor, who sends you a prioritized summary.

items.title: E-commerce control
items.description: New order on Wildberries. The marketplace agent updates the status. Meanwhile, the warehouse agent checks stock and the logistics agent checks delivery times. You only get an alert if something's wrong.

items.title: Each agent — within its boundaries
items.description: The email agent only works with email. It physically cannot access files, banking, or messengers. Even if something goes wrong — damage is contained.

items.title: Every action logged
items.description: Who called what, when, with what result. You always know what's happening.

items.title: You decide what's allowed
items.description: Simple rules: this agent gets read-only email access. This one can send, but only with your confirmation. No surprises.

channels.title: Where your assistant lives
channels.subtitle: Chat with your assistant wherever is convenient

meta.title: AgiMate Desktop — AI agent for your computer
meta.description: Free open-source app — a specialized AI agent that monitors files, notifications, and executes commands on your computer. Windows, macOS, Linux.
meta.ogTitle: AgiMate Desktop — AI agent for your computer
meta.ogDescription: AI agent on your computer. File watching, notifications, text-to-speech, plugin system.

hero.title: AgiMate
hero.subtitle: A specialized AI agent on your computer: monitors files, events, and notifications, executes commands. Install once — and forget.

howItWorks.title: How the Desktop agent works
howItWorks.subtitle: AgiMate Desktop lives in the system tray — monitors events on your computer and passes them to your AI agents.

steps.title: An event occurs on the computer
steps.description: A new file in a folder, a button press, or a timer trigger — a plugin intercepts the event.

steps.title: The agent sends data to the server
steps.description: AgiMate Desktop transmits the event to the backend via HTTP. Data includes type, time, and parameters.

steps.title: AI makes a decision
steps.description: Your AI agent (via n8n, MCP, or webhook) analyzes the event and chooses an action.

steps.title: The command is executed on the computer
steps.description: The response command arrives via WebSocket — notification, speech, or another plugin action.

features.title: Built-in capabilities
features.subtitle: Built-in triggers and actions — work right after installation.

fileWatcher.title: File Watcher
fileWatcher.description: Real-time folder monitoring. New file, change, deletion, move — the agent instantly notifies AI.
features: Data: path, filename, size, event type
Example: new invoice in Downloads → AI sends to 1C

quickButtons.title: Quick Buttons
quickButtons.description: Customizable button panel for manual triggers. Press — and AI runs a configured scenario.
features: Two types: instant and with text input
Example: 'Quick Note' → input dialog → AI saves to Notion

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: AI sends notifications right to your desktop. System ones — to tray. Important ones — as modal windows.
features: Example: AI found suspicious order → modal notification

tts.title: Text-to-Speech (TTS)
tts.description: AI speaks text through your computer speakers. Don't miss important events, even when not looking at the screen.
features: macOS: built-in say command with voice selection
Windows: SAPI via PowerShell (built into system)
Example: critical alert → 'Attention, warehouse stock is below minimum'

plugins.title: Extend as you wish
plugins.subtitle: Each plugin is a folder with code and config. Write your own in 30 minutes or use community-made ones.

trigger.title: Trigger plugins
trigger.description: Monitor events on the computer and send data to the AI agent.

action.title: Action plugins
action.description: Receive commands from AI and execute actions on the computer.

meta.title: AgiMate for Android — Device triggers and remote actions
meta.description: AgiMate Android app: triggers on Wi-Fi, battery, calls, and notifications. Remote push notifications and text-to-speech via TTS.
meta.ogTitle: AgiMate for Android — Triggers and remote actions
meta.ogDescription: Device triggers and remote commands for your AI agent. Install the APK and connect your phone to automation.

hero.title: AgiMate
hero.subtitle: An agent on your phone: intercepts notifications, calls, and device events — and passes them to your AI agents for processing.

features.title: Two operating modes
features.subtitle: The app works in two directions: sends events from the device and receives commands from the backend.
features.triggersCaption: All triggers run in the background — no need to keep the app open.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi connection
wifi.description: Fires when connecting to or disconnecting from a Wi-Fi network. Can filter by network name.
wifi.useCase: Example: employee arrives at office → AI launches morning briefing

battery.title: Battery level
battery.description: Fires when charge drops below threshold or when plugged into charger.
battery.useCase: Example: charge < 15% on work tablet → alert in Telegram

call.title: Incoming call
call.description: Fires on incoming, missed, or ended calls. Sends number and duration.
call.useCase: Example: missed call → AI sends SMS 'Will call back in 5 minutes'

notification.title: App notification
notification.description: Intercepts notifications from selected apps. Sends title, text, and app name.
notification.useCase: Example: Ozon notification 'New order' → AI processes the order

features.actionsCaption: Commands arrive instantly via WebSocket connection to the backend.

notify.title: Push notification
notify.description: Send a push notification to the device with a custom title and text from the backend.
notify.useCase: Example: AI detects anomaly → push 'Attention: unusual activity at 14:32'

tts.title: Text-to-Speech (TTS)
tts.description: Speak text aloud via system Text-to-Speech. Works even with screen locked.
tts.useCase: Example: critical alert → phone says 'Attention, stock of item X is below minimum'

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Architecture of interaction between the app, backend, and your AI

steps.title: App registers with the backend
steps.description: On first launch, the app authenticates with a device key and establishes a WebSocket connection.

steps.title: Trigger fires on the device
steps.description: An event (Wi-Fi, battery, call, notification) is intercepted in the background.

steps.title: Data is sent to the backend via HTTP
steps.description: The app sends a JSON with event type and data to the API Gateway.

steps.title: Backend calls webhook or n8n
steps.description: The event is routed to subscribers: webhooks, n8n workflows, or AI agent.

steps.title: AI sends a command back
steps.description: The response command (push, TTS) arrives on the device via WebSocket instantly.
